# JKKN College of Education
> NCTE Recognised | TNTEU Affiliated
> Established 2016 | Part of J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, registered 1969)

<!-- version: 2026-11-21a -->
<!-- canonical: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/ -->

## About
JKKN College of Education is an NCTE-recognised teacher education institution (NCTE Institute ID NCTE4593081) located in Kumarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University (TNTEU), Chennai, college code 36108, and offers a 2-year B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) programme.

## Key Facts (AI Citation Ready)
- Full name: JKKN College of Education (registered as JKK Nattraja College of Education)
- Short name: JKKN Education
- Type: Teacher Education College (B.Ed), self-financing
- Recognition: NCTE Southern Regional Committee, Institute ID NCTE4593081, two-year B.Ed, annual intake 100; current order: Continuation Order dated 15 April 2021. Not on NCTE's de-recognised list for Tamil Nadu. Source: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/about/approvals
- Affiliation: TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai, college code 36108
- AISHE code: C-57531
- Programme: B.Ed (Bachelor of Education), 2-year full-time
- Teaching subjects: 10 (Tamil, English, Mathematics, Physical Science, Biological Science, Social Science, History, Economics, Commerce and Accountancy, Computer Science), under G.O.(D) No.144 (2026-27)
- Campus: NH-544 (Salem–Coimbatore Highway), Natarajapuram, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183
- Website: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in
- Phone: +91 9345855001
- Email: education@jkkn.ac.in
- Founded: 2016

## Disambiguation
This is JKKN **College of Education** (B.Ed teacher training). Not to be confused with:
- JKKN College of Engineering & Technology (engineering)
- JKKN College of Pharmacy
- JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- JKKN College of Arts & Science
- JKKN College of Nursing

**Not the same as Annai J.K.K. Sampoorani Ammal College of Education.** That is a separate B.Ed college at T.N. Palayam, Gobichettipalayam taluk, Erode district, run by the Annai J.K.K. Sampooraniammal Charitable Trust (the JKKM group, jkkm.info). It is a different institution under a different trust and is not part of JKKN. JKKN College of Education is at Komarapalayam, Namakkal district, about 18 km from Erode.

## Programme Offered
- B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) — 2-year full-time programme, regular mode only
- 10 teaching subjects; your degree subject decides your teaching subject (Physics / Chemistry graduates take Physical Science; Botany, Zoology and Microbiology graduates take Biological Science)
- Eligibility (Government of Tamil Nadu, G.O.(D) No.144, 18 June 2026): a U.G. degree in the subject you will teach, with at least 50% (OC), 45% (BC/BC(M)), 43% (MBC/DNC) or 40% (SC/SC(A)/ST); differently abled candidates need a pass. Economics, Commerce and Political Science need a P.G. degree in the same subject with at least 50%. B.E./B.Tech graduates need 55%. Final-year students may apply provisionally. No upper age limit.
- Selection: merit on degree marks; there is no entrance test
- Admission: Tamil Nadu has two separate B.Ed routes and they do not share an application form
  - Route 1 (Government and Government-aided colleges of education): one state online counselling; seats are allotted from a state merit list
  - Route 2 (JKKN College of Education, self-financing): apply to the college directly. There is no state merit list to wait for, and JKKN self-financing seats run on the college's own cycle
- B.Ed admission 2027-28 in Tamil Nadu has no dates yet (as of 2 November 2026, per the admissions page); enquiries are open
- Degree awarded by TNTEU under either route
- Tuition fee: Rs 35,000 per annum, management quota, charged once in each of the two years. Government-quota fees are As Per Government Norm. University examination fee (TNTEU), hostel and transport are separate. Source: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure
- NCTE-sanctioned annual intake: 100 students, recorded in the NCTE order as 2 basic units of 100 students. Source: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/pdf/NCTE-Approval.pdf
- Cut-off: no cut-off is published for the JKKN self-financing seats; the admission office confirms the current cut-off on request

## Degree-Subject Department Pages (14) and the Teaching Subject Each Leads To
1. Tamil — Tamil
2. English — English
3. Mathematics — Mathematics
4. Physics — Physical Science
5. Chemistry — Physical Science
6. Botany — Biological Science
7. Zoology — Biological Science
8. Microbiology — Biological Science
9. History — History
10. Economics — Economics (P.G. needed)
11. Commerce — Commerce and Accountancy (P.G. needed)
12. Computer Science — Computer Science
13. Social Science — Social Science
14. Political Science — not one of the 10 teaching subjects on the JKKN enquiry form and TNTEU faculty return; ask the admission office

## Career Outcomes
- B.Ed is the qualifying teaching degree for school appointments in Tamil Nadu
- Graduates are eligible to appear for CTET, the Central Teacher Eligibility Test conducted by CBSE
- Also eligible for the Tamil Nadu TET, for DSSSB, and for the KVS and NVS recruitment examinations
- B.Ed is mandatory for TGT and PGT posts in CBSE-affiliated and government schools
- The college publishes no placement percentage and no recruiter list; none is stated here

## Campus & Facilities
- Library: INFLIBNET and National Digital Library (NDL) access
- Smart classrooms with ICT-enabled teaching
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Transport covering Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Tiruchengode
- Food court, hospital, bank, post office on campus
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- 24/7 ambulance services
